content: Balàbal u mii a Nzam
Mumay, atɔŋ amɛ, làkäl kà un'sak unsà Mwol. Kà mpay anki akà mɛ mufuur indiir akwà kàsön mɛ, anà bya byà ubwaŋ ntɔn bɛ.
Làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ akà mbwà, akà baar a isal abɛ anà akà bàŋàkyɛy a loor.
Wɛɛ kiin a baar bàkyɛy bà bi, ntɔn bi ifàsyääl Nzam unsà Dweelà, bi ibye anà ngaal mukal amu Klistɔ Yɛsu, wɛɛ kà uboo a ndür abi ŋakwo anki,
itàkal naa mɛ ŋakwo an'kwo in'si mpem amɛ u ndür. Isàkal naa mbuur asin akwen mupà mpem ande amu nde ŋakwo, mɛ, mɛ an'kwo in'kyer yàŋasöönà.
Ntɔn mɛ ban'kyɛy kà ilä kyànaan ungö a mböör amɛ. Mɛ in'wà un'nsi Isàlɛl, u mbil a Bɛnsàmɛn, Un'nsi Ebɛlyɔ mwan a Bebɛlyɔ, umfarisi unsà un'kɔɔn,
ntɔn un'kanà, mɛ kàmɛɛyà Ikööŋ nkwaaŋ. Ntɔn balàbal alà uboo a un'kɔɔn, akà pɛl mwɛy latɛy amu mɛ.
Wɛɛ indiir abi byanswà byakäl bweel ntɔn mɛ, apanà mɛ bya in'manà asanaa bwà ntɔn Klistɔ.

Inye, undiir wanswà mɛ in'kamanà asànaa wà bunàbun musi a ubwaŋ abà: ngyööb a Klistɔ Yɛsu, Mwol amɛ. Ntɔn nde, indiir byanswà byà bwà anà in'fàman bya asànaa nkayal, ntɔn muwal bweel: Klistɔ
anà mumɛnà amu nde, ukɔɔn akal anà balàbal amɛ lan'fà unsà un'kɔɔn, wɛɛ lan'fà unsà làkwikilà amu Klistɔ, balàbal lan'fà akà Nzam u mbwo a làkwikilà.
Mɛ in'kwen muyöb Klistɔ, ngwal a ngwiiyà ande anà un'tüüb u mpay ande, mubulà asànaa nde unsà ukwà ande,
ntɔn mutol, kya mbwo isàkal, u ngwiiyà a akü.
Ntiin ntɔn muwal iböŋ
Iswaŋà anki naa mɛ kàkyàwal indiir abi byanswà, itàkal naa mɛ kàkyàkwo. Wɛɛ mɛ in'wàmulab ntiin amɛ ntɔn mɛ in'wɛl bya, ntɔn mɛ ŋakwo sye Yɛsu kàkyan'wal.
Atɔŋ, mɛ in'sii naa mɛ ŋàtàwal anki akà undiir mwɛy. Wɛɛ mɛ in'fàkyer undiir mwɛy mpɛl: mudiimà indiir abyà ungö anà mudüül indiir abyà kusà.
Abun, mɛ in'wà mukaamà ntiin tii u ntsüü, ntɔn mɛ in'wɛl mban a mbeel a Nzam fà du u mbwo a Klistɔ Yɛsu.
Bi banswà, baar aŋàtsim unsà Dweelà, ifàyweer abun. Apan sye, isàkal naa bɛ làwe anà undiir asin làyweerà, Nzam akyer ayàlamɛɛy wa.
Itàkal kà aben, kà ikal ban'kɔlà bi ki, wɛy bi ilalà mukyà mbwo mwɛy.
Atɔŋ, bɛ banswà làläb mbaan amɛ, anà làsi iler abɛ akà baar bàfàlab mbaan ayi.
Ntɔn, bàmbɔɔn, u mbwo a nkääl aba, bà ayiiŋ a kulunsi a Klistɔ, asànaa in'fàtɛn mɛ a bɛ mbalà mbɔɔn anà in'fàfuur mɛ apanà anà nsaaŋ u mii:
ntsüü aba isàkal ukwà, nzam aba wà an'bäl aba, làkoo aba ba bàfàsà unsà indiir a nswɛn aba, an'kyän aba mà unsà indiir a mɛɛn.
Wɛɛ akà bi, bi ibà baar a du, ntsü uyàfà Un'tswää a mɔ̈ɔ̈ abi ikadilà bi, Mwol Yɛsu Klistɔ.
Apan, nde asàsɔɔm ndür abi yà nswɛn ntɔn mubuul ya asànaa ndür ande yà làkoo, u mbwo a ngwal ande ifun'pà mbwo musà indiir byanswà ungyɛl a ikɔ̈b ande.
